seal.statement: A refused consensus startup retains its primary typed immutable consensus answer and original retry information when existing lifecycle cleanup fails. Cleanup failure remains visible, exact acquired handles remain owned until released, new initialization cannot overwrite them, and retrying the existing shutdown finishes the same release before a new instance opens. No new scheduler, durable ledger, cleanup coordinator or deadline is introduced. All three production service initializers and their existing lifecycle owners participate.
